notes: Cash-basis county, governmental funds only. Statement lines from Exhibit D Total Governmental Funds column (p4). Cash and fund balance kept separate: beginning/ending fund balance from Exhibit D; ending cash = Equity in Pooled Cash and Cash Equivalents (Balance Sheet p3), Designated Deposits 4,826,408 in ending_investments; beginning cash not printed. Bond Proceeds 4,001,143 (Capital Outlay Highway Allocation fund) and Component Unit 118,508 (Hospital Bond debt service fund) printed under Other Financing Sources: debt_proceeds and other_financing. Balance sheet from the governmental funds Balance Sheet - Cash Basis (totals equal the Statement of Net Position 14,606,406). General Fund budget 'Taxes' 3,204,016 split into Property Taxes 2,952,818 and Motor Vehicle Tax 251,198 from the General Fund column of Exhibit D (adds exactly); General 'Local' and Road 'Local' kept as broad groups (category other; context label); Road 'State' kept as other state aid (no highway allocation label printed). Inheritance Tax 'Local' 508,134 is printed as Inheritance Tax on Exhibit D. Nonmajor funds recorded per fund column from the combining schedules (Schedules 2 and 3, pp9-12); the nonmajor budget schedules (Schedule 4, pp13-16) print only fund totals and are not recorded (no double counting). Veteran's Aid fund had no activity; zero-actual budget lines (Public Works Miscellaneous) omitted. The major Capital Outlay Highway Allocation fund (interest 186, bond proceeds 4,001,143 on Exhibit D) has no schedule in the trimmed PDF, so it has no detail lines. Transfers: General -> Road 954,716; E-911 2,040 and Wireless 911 4,238 -> Wireless 911 Holding 6,278. All roll-forwards tie. Read pages 1-16 of 16
